subject: Boundary Assurance: Evergreen AI SIG Roadmap & Diagram Handoff
messages:
From: Audrey Lin <audrey.lin@evergreen.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.inference
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@evergreen.ai>, security@evergreen.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG mapping + network diagram for Evergreen evaluation

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and routing options you showed. We are starting the SIG review for our security committee and need a compact packet we can attach to the vendor evaluation. Specifically we need:

- A single-page network diagram that highlights control plane vs data plane boundaries for Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private.
- A SIG mapping sheet that shows which SIG controls are satisfied by which artifacts (diagrams, logs, KMS notes).
- A short SOC 2 evidence index that points to where you store attestation artifacts (S3/Drive links, retention windows).

Can you send a concise package (ideally <3 files) by end of day Friday? If you prefer, we can accept a short handoff link to a Drive folder.

Thanks — we are on a tight timeline for vendor gating.

Best,
Audrey Lin
Security Program Manager
Evergreen AI

---
Attachment: vendor-checklist-template.pdf (referenced)

From: priyom.das@redwood.inference
To: Audrey Lin <audrey.lin@evergreen.ai>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.inference, ben.carter@redwood.inference, grace.oconnor@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG mapping + network diagram for Evergreen evaluation

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear ask and for the time yesterday.

We can assemble a compact packet that covers the three items. Plan:

1) Network diagram: Kimberly will produce an annotated PNG showing Dedicated vs Private deployment boundaries, where control-plane services live (management plane, telemetry, KMS) and where customer data paths terminate.

2) SIG mapping: We'll include a one-sheet matrix mapping common SIG controls (network segregation, key management, logs) to the artifacts and retention policies.

3) SOC 2 index: A brief index (PDF) that lists the evidentiary locations and retention windows. We will avoid sharing any full raw logs in this packet; links will point to read-only Drive locations or evidence indexes.

Deliverable ETA: Friday EOD PT (2026-09-11 23:00 PT). If you need earlier, say which item is highest priority.

Assigning: Kimberly (diagram), Ben (SIG crosswalk + cover notes), Naomi (SOC 2 index). Grace will validate the control-plane language for Private deployments.

Regards,

--
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198

Audrey / team — attached are the three files you requested. Quick notes below and a short executive summary to help your committee.

Executive summary:
- Packet includes: redwood_inference_network-diagram_v1.png, sig-mapping_matrix_vEvergreen.xlsx, soc2-evidence-index_evgnai.pdf
- Diagram highlights: control plane (management API endpoints, KMS/HSM integration, telemetry collectors) is logically separated from data path nodes. Dedicated pools are labeled; Private deployment example shows VPC peering and optional on-prem edge.
- SIG crosswalk: Mapping shows primary artifacts satisfying controls (diagram: architecture; logs: traffic/ingestion logs; KMS notes: key lifecycle policy; retention: 365/90/30 days depending on artifact).

Important clarifications (short):
- The diagram is illustrative and uses canonical naming; IP ranges are redacted. For any production onboarding we supply environment-specific VPC diagrams under an NDA.
- SOC 2 index points to our evidence index (read-only Drive) and includes the retention windows and the owner for each artifact (ex: telemetry: infra-ops@redwood.inference).

Attachments (in Drive and attached inline):
- redwood_inference_network-diagram_v1.png — single-page, annotated.
- sig-mapping_matrix_vEvergreen.xlsx — crosswalk with tabs: ControlSummary, Artifacts, Retention
- soc2-evidence-index_evgnai.pdf — page-by-page index for quick committee review

Next steps / asks from Evergreen:
- Can you confirm whether the committee would like a labeled flow for your prospective Private VPC peering pattern (we can generate if you share a contact for network ops)?
- If an NDA is required to push environment-level diagrams, we can sign a mutual NDA and then deliver the specifics.

Regards,

Kimberly Park
Security Architect
Redwood Inference
